hooks.name: Check spec against rubric on save
hooks.description: Keeps requirements, design, and tasks aligned with the hackathon rubric and spec standards.

action.prompt: A spec file was just saved. Check it against .kiro/steering/spec-standards.md and product.md: category stated, persona and success metric present, EARS acceptance criteria, rubric tags ([Tech40] [Impact25] [Innov25] [UX10]) on requirements, a Gen AI design section in design.md (models, prompts, schemas, tools, grounding, safety, evals), GCP-only architecture, and tasks that reach a deployed vertical slice early with verification steps. List gaps in 5 bullets or fewer; do not rewrite the spec unless asked.
